title: Setup › 审计日志: the Object column and the detail drawer show the object's API name (sys_flow_dispatch) instead of its label
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class b, from the #28895 os-dev-report (6569458627, PR #28962) · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** Setup › 审计日志 names the object of each event by its API name (`sys_flow_dispatch`, `crm_account`). Since #28895 the Action column of the same row reads the declared label (更新 / 创建), so a zh-CN admin reads 更新 beside `crm_account` and has to know the API name to tell which business object changed.

**Measured (PR #28962 at `5e134182`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`).**
- The Object column prints `r.object_name` (line 663).
- The detail drawer's title prints `selected.object_name` (line 703), and its target-record line prints `object_name / record_id` (line 732).
- The page already holds the served objects (`useMetadata().objects`) and the Object filter labels them as "Label (name)" through `objectFilterOptionsOf(objects, displayLocale)`. The column and the drawer do not reuse it.

**Wanted.**
1. The Object column, the drawer title and the drawer's target line show the object's label in the display locale, from the objects the page already reads (one helper beside the filter's, ⛔ no second map). An object the metadata does not serve shows its stored name, as now.
2. Decide once how the three sites spell it (label only, or "Label (name)" as the filter does) and use that everywhere. The filter itself stays as it is.
3. No new metadata key and no new gate.

**Tests.** A row whose `object_name` is a served object shows its label in the column and the drawer. A row naming an unserved object shows the stored name.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. Size S. Files: `AuditLogPage.tsx`, its helper module and tests. Runs after PR #28962 lands (same file).

**Dedupe.** Searched `audit log object column label`, `sys_audit_log object_name label`, `审计日志 对象 列`: #28895 (the source, action only), #24611 (closed; plugin-audit record titles and grouping, not this console page), #25893 (closed; the page's chrome strings, not the cell values).

Links back: #28895, PR #28962.
